activeSlice.scope: Extend Hunter V1 comparability diagnostics into operational cohort preflight so rejected persisted/disposable/ephemeral Brands retain their exact fail-closed reason and measured values instead of being silently dropped.
successCriteria: Every rejected cohort preflight records origin, Brand name/key, rejection reason and exact comparability failures.
Control execution errors remain fail-closed and are preserved in screening diagnostics.
Control non-comparability records evidenceCount, modelInvocationCount, criticalDependencyDegraded, costUsd, latencyMs and recommendationCount.
No comparability predicate or rollout threshold changes.
Hunter V1 remains production authority; no V2 persistence, canary, scheduler or production enablement.
PES v2 CI and Security baseline pass before merge/deployment.
The same 3x3 pre-gate is rerun on the exact merge SHA before any 30-pair gate.

priorPreGateEvidence.reason: Cohort construction ended with fewer than three comparable Brands. The preflight path silently discarded the exact rejection reason, so paired-batch diagnostics never ran.
